name: Shared Groceries
description: Shopping lists, items, quantities, units, stores, substitutions, and purchased state. Uses an existing Collaboration space and its membership.
captureExamples: We need milk, oats, and two lemons.
notes: This is a concrete standard extension, generated from Groceries authoring source. Record payload schema identities are shared; membership comes only from the existing Collaboration space.
Use this variant when the user has selected a shared space. Standalone Groceries remains appropriate for independently shared roots. Do not write the same fact into both variants.

Admin and editor powers are explicitly declared per path. The owner controls space membership and subtree pruning. Personal root-level state is excluded from the shared subtree; keep it in the user's own module.

capture.identity: Select the existing Collaboration space first. Match the selected list and item, including quantity/variant distinctions.
exclude: Writing the same fact to both the standalone and shared variant. Existing pantry inventory or an aspirational gift wishlist.
capture.workflow: Record shopping intent, then update purchase state when known; link purchases and pantry items instead of copying their histories. Membership comes from the selected space; keep personal state outside the shared subtree.
